en.name: Caesar
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st time an evil player dies by execution, that night, choose an additional player: they die.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st time an evil player dies by execution, that night, choose an additional player: they die.

en.flavor: "I came, I saw, I conquered." - Gaius Julius Caesar 100 B.C. - 44 B.C.
en.otherNightReminder: If an evil player was executed today, Caesar points to two players. Otherwise: Caesar points to a player. Chosen players die.

zh.name: 凯撒
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。首个邪恶玩家死于处决的当晚，你要额外选择一名玩家：他死亡。

revisions.v1: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。首个邪恶玩家死于处决的当晚，你要额外选择一名玩家：他死亡。

zh.flavor: ‘我来，我见，我征服。’-盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·凯撒 前100-前44
zh.otherNightReminder: 唤醒凯撒，让他选择一名玩家。如果一名邪恶玩家首次在今天白天死于处决，让凯撒选择另一名玩家。
